scope.notes: The 6M-active-users milestone in OpenAI's stated commitment to reset Codex usage limits at every additional million weekly active users up to 10M. Reported as carrying TWO distinct effects: an immediate usage reset, AND removal of the existing 5-hour usage cap on Plus, Business and Pro. The cap removal reportedly persisted through the following weeks. Plan list applies to the cap removal specifically; the reset itself is described by product ("Codex and ChatGPT Work") rather than by tier.

notes: ⚠️ PROVISIONAL — NOT SEALED, AND NOT AN ASSERTION THAT THIS EVENT IS DISTINCT. Created 2026-07-26 on operator instruction, because a gap with no marker reads as "didn't happen".
